lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 ↿(fun s y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) :=
    fun j => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
    (c := 𝓕.c) (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  have hg : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    have hG := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => ∂[i] f x)
      (funext (fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1))
    unfold Space.div at hG
    rw [Space.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)] at hG
    simpa only [Space.deriv_eq, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul,
      fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t).differentiableAt,
      _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hG
  have ht : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) = fun s =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
      (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) x), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hc : 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) = (𝓕.c : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm]
  have hcμ : (𝓕.c : ℝ) ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ = 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ := by
    simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq, one_div, mul_inv_rev]
    rw [mul_right_comm, inv_mul_cancel₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, one_mul]
  rw [ht, Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
  profile_tactic "eval" in simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  profile_tactic "comm-time" in simp_rw [fun j => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hB j) t x]
  profile_tactic "faraday" in simp_rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl))]
  profile_tactic "deriv-sub" in simp_rw [fun j => Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i)]
  profile_tactic "comm-space" in simp_rw [fun j => Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j)]
  profile_tactic "algebra" in simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, hc, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_one_div, hcμ]
